description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. South Sound 911 emergency-service-zone polygons define sheriff patrol blocks and patrol districts, registered to the CAD system and road/annexation geography. Districts are explicitly derived by dissolving the block zones by district. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for emergency response studies. The two geometry levels are one service-zone resource. Boundaries do not establish staffing, response times or emergency demand. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
